name: SOMATOM Definition dual-source CT
description: Siemens combined two X-ray tubes and their corresponding detector arrays on a rotating CT gantry. The arrangement was demonstrated for faster cardiac imaging and also supported dual-energy acquisition.

date.basis: Online publication date of the evaluation.

events.statement: Flohr and colleagues reported the dual-source scanner’s geometry, phantom tests and initial patient imaging.

evidence.supports: Reports the rotating pair of tube-detector systems and initial patient and dual-energy images.
Names the 2005 Siemens dual-source scanner SOMATOM Definition.

earliest_record.rationale: The dated performance paper documents a working system. Its date does not date the first scan.

links.statement: The Siemens scanner retains computer reconstruction from X-ray transmission projections taken at different angles, the imaging principle used in the earlier clinical brain scanner.
links.scope: Shared reconstruction principle across different instruments.
links.caveats: No specific transfer of EMI apparatus or detector design to SOMATOM Definition is established.

evidence.supports: Describes reconstruction of cross sections from a rotating X-ray CT system for clinical imaging.
Describes the earlier computer reconstruction of clinical slices from X-ray transmission measurements.
